So f(x) = (x + 2)(x - 1)(x - 2) = (x + 2)(x² - 3x + 2) = x³ - x² - 4x + 4.

Check: f(0) = 4 ✓; f(-1) = -1 - 1 + 4 + 4 = 6 ✓; local min near x ≈ 1.5 with value ≈ -0.9 ✓.

Thus b = -1 (with c = -4, d = 4).
